name: Mayor's Community Nature Fund

funder.name: West of England Mayoral Combined Authority

summary: Match funding for community crowdfunding campaigns on Spacehive that restore nature in the West of England and North Somerset, such as habitat improvement, tree planting and wildlife-friendly land management.

geography.label: West of England and North Somerset

amount.note: Or up to 50% of the crowdfunding target

reporting: Deliver the project within nine months of crowdfunding and complete a mandatory impact report on Spacehive.

administered_by.quote: A crowdfunding platform has been created by the West of England Mayoral Combined Authority and Spacehive

applicant_types.quote: Public bodies (eg. parish councils, schools supporting their wider community) Registered charities and Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs) Community Interest Companies (CICs) Constituted or unincorporated community groups

geography.quote: Projects delivered or run by organisations based outside of the West of England Mayoral Combined Authority and North Somerset Council areas

access.quote: Head to spacehive.com/create to get started.

amount.quote: with a maximum award of up to £6,000, or up to 50% of your campaign target

reporting.quote: deliver your project within nine months and complete an impact report on Spacehive. This is mandatory
